meta.name: permissions
meta.description: Recommend safe Bash permissions for Elixir mix commands in settings.json. Use when permission prompts slow workflow, "fix permissions", "reduce prompts", "auto-allow mix".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动配置 Bash 权限，免去 Elixir mix 命令的繁琐提示。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常被 Elixir mix 命令的权限提示打断工作。
copy.tagline_en: Auto-configure Bash permissions to suppress prompts for Elixir mix commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of repeated permission prompts when running Elixir mix commands.

howto.what: Claude会扫描最近N天的会话记录，找出你已批准的Bash命令，与当前settings.json对比，推荐添加缺失的低风险命令（GREEN/YELLOW），并清理冗余或垃圾条目。
howto.when: 使用“/phx:permissions”命令（可带--days和--dry-run参数），或当你说“fix permissions”“reduce prompts”“auto-allow mix”等时触发。

say.text: 扫描我最近14天的权限请求
say.note: Claude会分析会话并给出建议。
自动检查并清理冗余条目。
尝试推荐添加mix相关权限。

howto.what_en: Claude scans recent session transcripts (last N days), extracts Bash commands you approved, compares with current settings.json, and recommends adding missing GREEN/YELLOW commands and removing redundant/garbage entries.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the "/phx:permissions" command (with optional --days and --dry-run), or when you say "fix permissions", "reduce prompts", "auto-allow mix", etc.

say_en.text: Scan my permissions requests from the last 14 days
say_en.note: Claude analyzes sessions and gives recommendations.
Auto-check and clean up redundant entries.
Tries to recommend adding mix-related permissions.
